description: GridPath is a versatile power system planning platform that supports production cost, capacity expansion, asset valuation and reliability or resource adequacy modelling within one software ecosystem built on a common database structure. It is developed and maintained by Sylvan Energy Analytics with a community of contributors; the software citation lists Ana Mileva, Gerrit De Moor and Ranjit Deshmukh. The platform is location independent: users build a scenario database for any power system and select which planning approach to run. It is a Python package on PyPI (version 2026.11.2, uploaded 22 September 2026, tested on Python 3.11 to 3.14) with source on GitHub, documentation on read-the-docs and releases archived on Zenodo, under the Apache 2.0 licence at no cost. Caveats: the repository moved from the blue-marble organisation to sylvan-energy on GitHub, so older links point to the former address; Sylvan also sells training, and the modelling depends on a separately chosen solver and on user-supplied input data. Simulation uses are capacity planning, production cost optimisation and reliability analysis. Related records: it compares with model-genx, model-switch and model-pypsa.
